availability.note: bydautomotive.com.au/configurator/byd-atto-2 301-redirects to this BYD Build & Price flow, which lists ATTO 2 Dynamic $31,990 and Premium $35,990 on 2026-11-26

listPrice.note: CarExpert 24 Sep 2026 pricing table: 2027 Atto 2 EV Dynamic $31,990 'before on-road costs' in words; BYD configurator (https://evdealergroup-byd.com.au/configurator/byd-atto-2) shows the same $31,990 unlabelled under an NSW drive-away banner, but it is below the computed Victorian drive-away, so per rule 3 it is the list price

batteryKwh.note: EV Database (UK, same 51.1 kWh variant): usable 51.1 kWh, nominal 53.0 kWh, so BYD's 51.13 kWh rated figure is the usable capacity; CarExpert prints 51.3 (typo)

rangeKm.note: BYD AU spec table labels 345 km WLTP for both grades; cross-checked against EV Database UK WLTP 214 mi (344 km) for the same 51.1 kWh pack, so not an NEDC submission. AU 16-inch wheel; BYD quotes one figure for both grades

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: CarExpert specs article: claimed 17.1 kWh/100km (WLTP); EV Database UK gives 277 Wh/mi = 17.2 kWh/100km. Battery/range gives 14.8, gap is charging losses (plug-to-wheel)

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: BYD AU spec table 380 L; measurement method not stated, believed VDA to the cover; EV Database lists 400 L. No frunk added

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: BYD AU spec table 1,320 L seats folded; CarExpert same

towKg.note: 750 kg braked both grades; EV Database UK also 750 kg braked. BYD AU page does not state towing

warrantyYears.note: 6 years/150,000 km vehicle, unconditional; battery 8 years/160,000 km

insuranceAnnual.note: held value kept; anchored to mg-4-urban-54 ($32,735, $1,300) and below byd-atto3-essential ($39,990, $1,500)

depreciationCurve.note: BYD brand curve shared with byd-atto1 and byd-dolphin (one curve per brand); byd-atto3 now uses a different curve [1,0.77,0.63,0.51,0.44,0.39], flagged to orchestrator
